segmentation.text: intending to turn to the left
to any vehicle approaching from the opposite direction
or so close thereto as to constitute an immediate hazard,
but such driver, having so yielded
and the drivers of all other vehicles
approaching the intersection from the opposite direction
to the vehicle making the left turn.

elements.justification: The turning vehicle y is of the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle; 'the driver' is read through its controlled motion.
'within an intersection': rel.occupies 'a road user's footprint overlaps a lane / region' of y and the st.intersection x approaches.

'having given a signal': sig.turn_indicator state left ('the signal that precedes a manoeuvre') or sig.hand_signal meaning left ('a driver's or rider's arm signal'), at some observation since y last came onto its approach carrier c2 (drv.motion.entering_region y c2: 'its footprint overlaps r (rel.occupies) at the observation and did not at the observation before'), c2 being the carrier (st.travel_region, st.lane_enters c2 i) y occupied at its latest entry into the intersection, y having occupied c2 or the intersection at every observation since. Neither signal is a stand-in for the turn itself, which s11 reads.

'may make such left turn': y is making it, turning left now (drv.motion.turning_left: moving, kin.yaw_rate left positive above resolution) or having turned left since entering the intersection by at least the turn recognition angle (drv.motion.heading_change_since_entry 'the signed heading change of road user x since its footprint last began to overlap region r').
'the drivers of all other vehicles': x, any vehicle of the admitted aggregate other than the turning one, read through its controlled motion.

'approaching the intersection': x occupies an approach carrier c (st.lane_enters 'the intersection region a directed approach carrier runs into at its entrance end') and its yield is decided at its entry (drv.motion.entering_region). 'from the opposite direction' relative to the turning vehicle: c and the carrier y occupied at its latest entry into the intersection (drv.motion.entering_region y i, read through a past operator) have opposed designated directions (drv.road.opposed_directions), as rel.oncoming's 'not a stand-in' clause directs.
'shall yield the right-of-way' (DEF-NRS-484A-210): x does not enter the intersection while the turning vehicle is owed precedence.
'the vehicle making the left turn': the vehicle y (admitted aggregate) in the intersection that s11 reads as making the turn.

intentions.meaning: The source's current plan for the road user includes a left turn at the target region.

residues.why: 'when and as required' refers to the signalling requirements of a law outside this corpus (no bracketed id resolves it); the signal itself is read on s9.

applicability: x is a vehicle (ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle) and enters intersection i (st.intersection) at this observation (drv.motion.entering_region x i) from an approach carrier c it occupies at this observation (rel.occupies x c, st.travel_region, st.lane_enters c i).
obligation: At this entry no vehicle y other than x (ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle) is making a left turn in i under the words' conditions: y occupies i and, read through a past operator, has occupied i at every observation since its latest entry into i (drv.motion.entering_region y i), at which entry observation y occupied a carrier c2 (rel.occupies y c2, st.travel_region, st.lane_enters c2 i) with drv.road.opposed_directions c c2 (p.opposed_carriers_cosine); the source declares int.left_turn y i; y is making the turn (drv.motion.turning_left y with p.speed_resolution and p.yaw_rate_resolution, or drv.motion.heading_change_since_entry y i with step p.heading_since_step_carla_scene_graph at least p.turn_recognition_angle); y has so yielded (rule NRS_484B_253_o1 {x -> y} complied with at every observation since y's latest entry into i); and y has given a signal (sig.turn_indicator left, or sig.hand_signal left) at some observation since y last came onto c2 (drv.motion.entering_region y c2), y having occupied c2 or i at every observation since. Where y's entry into i or onto c2 is not observed, the conditions that turn on it are unknown.

narrowings.why: 'the driver' of the turning vehicle is read through its controlled motion.
'the drivers' are read through the vehicles' controlled motion.
The yield is judged at x's entry into the intersection while the turning vehicle is in it.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: The recording begins with y on a carrier upstream of c2; y comes onto c2 and signals with sig.turn_indicator left on c2, int.left_turn y i declared, enters i through c2 (recorded), waits in i while no opposing vehicle is near, and now turns left (kin.yaw_rate 15 deg/s, 4 m/s); x on c (opposed to c2) enters i.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: x waits on c and enters i after y has left it, as the only road user in i.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: x drives along a road segment and enters no intersection.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, with y's arrival on c2 and its entry into i recorded, but neither sig.turn_indicator nor sig.hand_signal of y is observed.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, but y's sig.turn_indicator is off and sig.hand_signal no_signal at every observation: y gave no signal, and x owes it no precedence under this duty.

scenarios.name: branch_2
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, but y began its turn while x was 15 m from i at 15 m/s on c, so NRS_484B_253_o1 was not complied with by y: y has not so yielded.
